Author and Citation Information for "Anaxagoras"

The latest version of the entry may be cited via the earliest archive in which it appears:

Sisko, John and Patricia Curd, "Anaxagoras", The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (Fall 2026 Edition), Edward N. Zalta & Uri Nodelman (eds.), URL = <https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/fall2026/entries/anaxagoras/>.
The citation immediately above refers to the version in the following archive edition:
  • Fall 2026 (substantive content change) [new author(s): Sisko, John; Curd, Patricia]

Please note that you are being asked to cite a URL that is in a fixed, archived edition of the encyclopedia. The reason for this is that the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy recommends that readers cite a stable document for scholarly purposes. You should not cite the dynamic portion of the encyclopedia.

Archive Schedule
Spring:March 21
Summer:June 21
Fall: September 21
Winter:December 21

Older versions of "Anaxagoras" are available in the following editions:

  • Fall 2007 (first archived) [author: Curd, Patricia]
This entry was first published on Wed Aug 22, 2007. It was last modified on Aug 9, 2026.

BibTeX Citation String (Current Version in Fall 2026 Archive)

There are over 50 BibTeX styles and no standard format that is guaranteed to work for all 50. So, we suggest you use our string as a 'useful suggestion' that might need to be adapted for your particular BibTeX file. Also note that the double braces around the title is to preserve capitalization. You may wish to edit that as well.

@InCollection{sep-anaxagoras,
	author       =	{Sisko, John and Curd, Patricia},
	title        =	{{Anaxagoras}},
	booktitle    =	{The {Stanford} Encyclopedia of Philosophy},
	editor       =	{Edward N. Zalta and Uri Nodelman},
	howpublished =	{\url{https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/fall2026/entries/anaxagoras/}},
	year         =	{2026},
	edition      =	{{F}all 2026},
	publisher    =	{Metaphysics Research Lab, Stanford University}
}
